name: tactic
description: Self-hosted tactical situational awareness + PTT voice intercom for airsoft

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.android:sync: npm run build -w client && npx --prefix client cap sync android
